title: Accelerated and Stable Convergence with Anchored Generalized Optimistic Method
summary: We study first-order methods for solving monotone variational inequalities arising in min-max optimization. Classical approaches such as the extragradient method rely on two gradient queries per iteration, which limits their analysis and applicability in the online and stochastic settings. We propose a family of Generalized Optimistic Methods with Anchoring (GOMA), which combine two-time-scale optimistic updates with an anchoring term inspired by Halpern iteration. In the deterministic setting, GOMA achieves the optimal accelerated last-iterate rate $O(1/k^2)$ on the squared gradient norm…
